blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “I am deeply saddened by the passing of Quirino Governor Dakila Carlo “Dax” Cua,” House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy said in a statement on Wednesday. “For those of us who knew and worked with Dax, we mourn more than the loss of a leader. We mourn a colleague and a kailian [countryman] whose commitment to public service touched so many lives,” Dy added. “His service extended far beyond Quirino,” he added. READ: Quirino Gov.
